description: Find the page-2 quick wins in the user's own Google Search Console data: queries ranking 11-20 worth working on first, each with an opportunity score and an estimate of the extra clicks from moving onto page 1. The API does not connect to Search Console: pass the exported rows or the CSV export text. Nothing is stored. The click numbers are estimates. Works on every plan; counts as one audit. Up to 1 MB per request.

csv.description: The Performance export as text, with a header row. Use instead of rows.

exclude_terms.description: Words to leave out, such as the brand name.

rows.description: Rows like {query, page, clicks, impressions, position}. `page` is optional.

name: quick_wins
